## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue/plan feature ID.

## Validation

- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes.
- [ ] Relevant tests and the complete `flutter test` suite pass.
- [ ] Appropriate Android build succeeds.
- [ ] Device behavior was tested, or the untested device checks are listed below.

## Data and UI

- [ ] Existing records are preserved; schema changes include a migration and tests if applicable.
- [ ] Linked wages, stock and financial totals remain consistent if affected.
- [ ] English/Kannada text and documentation are updated if affected.
- [ ] No private credentials or real farm records are included.

## Limitations / remaining checks

List account dependencies, manual phone tests and any known limitations. Mark non-applicable checklist items explicitly.
